description: Open a new browser tab (automatically creates a new browser window if none exists, and waits for page load completion by default). Defaults to active: false to never interrupt user focus.

password.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password (automatically URL-encoded into the target URL, safe for special characters like && or #)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after opening tab

username.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username (automatically URL-encoded into the target URL)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after opening tab

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after opening tab

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after opening tab (saves a separate wait call)

waitUntil.description: Wait for tab load completion before returning (default: true)
